prompt.project_info: A cheerful three-panel spring collage using yellow flower fields, a pale green-and-yellow outfit, and hand-drawn decorative marks.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with short-to-medium tousled dark waves, soft natural makeup, and a lively smile. She wears a light-green T-shirt under a soft yellow pinafore midi dress and a straw hat with fabric ties.
prompt.composition_elements: Three stacked vertical panels within a 3:4 collage: top is a back view with arms open in a yellow flower field; middle is a close-up resting face on one hand with the other hand toward camera; bottom is a low-angle peace-sign portrait amid flowers. Use abstract white doodle flowers, smile marks, and lines only; no readable lettering.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong clear spring daylight at 5600K with slightly lifted highlights, fresh sky blue/yellow/light-green palette, gentle highlight bloom, real flower detail, and a clean nostalgic digital-film finish.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 35mm lens at f/2.8 for each panel, vertical 3:4 collage, shallow perspective emphasis in the middle and bottom panels, natural grain and realistic hands.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Bright playful three-panel vertical 3:4 spring photo collage featuring an adult woman in a broad yellow rapeseed flower field under a clear blue sky. She has short-to-medium tousled dark waves, wears a light-green T-shirt under a soft yellow pinafore midi dress and a straw hat with fabric ties. Top panel: back view with arms open; middle: smiling close-up, face resting on one hand and the other reaching toward camera; bottom: low-angle portrait making a peace sign among flowers. Fresh daylight, slightly lifted highlights, yellow/light-green/sky-blue palette, soft nostalgic film-digital finish, abstract white doodle flowers and lines only, no readable text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands
